g.text: Studio: sensitivity to local 3D sampling tilt
PHerc0841 author holdout · 17 cores · 13 conditions · 16,516 identical scored physical pixels

g.text: All prespecified angles are shown. Lines connect measured conditions; no angle is selected or averaged.

g.text: One exposed author region; spatially related cores. No IID-pixel intervals, unseen-scroll accuracy, or readability claim.
